SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / Police & A.B. REGISTRY. / No. D 5512 / Date December 4 / 12 - / 33）
Subject (in full) V. M. Loseff, applicant for Bodyguard Licence.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the attached memo of the Personal
Assistant (Crime Branch) dated November 27, 1933, on the subject
of V.M. Loseff, applicant for a bodyguard licence, this
individual's history and record as known to this office are as
follows:-
Valentin Mihailovitch Loseff, Russian, born 24-4-1910 at
Chita, Province of Transbaikalia, Russia. He arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin on September 1, 1929, and has been since
residing in this city with his parents (Present address : No. 96
Avenue Dubail). On December 1, of the same year he joined
the Russian Regiment, S.V.C., with which he served until June 1,
1930 when he resigned of his own accord. From September 15,
1930 till November 2, 1931 he attended private school for wireless
operators established in the French Concession under the auspices
of the "Caisse des Oeuvres d'Interet Public de la Concession
Francaise de Changhai." During this period, as well as
during 10 months period of unemployment after leaving the above
school, he was supported by his family. On 31.8.1932 he
secured position as a ticket inspector with the Omnibus Company
and worked in this capacity until 7.5.33 when he was discharged
"for making a false entry in checking sheet." Since that
time he has been unemployed.
Loseff was registered with the Shanghai Municipal Police
as a candidate for position as a watchman and/or bodyguard on
September 5, 1933.
About a week ago he was engaged through the French Police
as a bodyguard at the pay of $50. per month by Mr. Kwauh Yu Chow
(郭讀舟), House 1, Passage 64, Rue Paul Beau, to whom he had
been introduced by his friend, I.V. Goretovsky. The latter was

特务科第二股。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 警务及外侨登记处。/ 编号 D 5512 / 日期 1933年12月4日）
事由（全称） V. M. Loseff，保镖执照申请人。
呈报人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人：[签名]
兹参照刑事科私人助理于1933年11月27日就保镖执照申请人V.M. Loseff一事所附备忘录，本处所知悉之该员履历及记录如下：-
瓦伦丁·米哈伊洛维奇·洛谢夫（Valentin Mihailovitch Loseff），俄国人，1910年4月24日出生于俄罗斯外贝加尔省赤塔。他于1929年9月1日从哈尔滨抵达上海，此后一直与父母居住在本市（现住址：杜美路96号）。同年12月1日，他加入上海万国商团俄国分队，服役至1930年6月1日自愿辞职。从1930年9月15日至1931年11月2日，他在法租界就读于一所私立无线电操作员学校，该校由“上海法租界公益基金会”（Caisse des Oeuvres d'Interet Public de la Concession Francaise de Changhai）资助设立。在此期间，以及离开上述学校后失业的10个月期间，均由其家庭供养。1932年8月31日，他在英商公共汽车公司谋得查票员一职，并在此岗位工作至1933年5月7日，因“在查票单上作虚假记录”而被解雇。自那时起，他一直处于失业状态。
洛谢夫于1933年9月5日在上海公共租界工部局警务处登记，申请担任看门人和/或保镖职位。
约一周前，他经法国巡捕介绍，受雇于郭读舟先生（地址：保罗·博路64弄1号），担任保镖，月薪50元。介绍人是他的朋友I.V. Goretovsky（音译）。后者曾
